question: 2024/2025 comparability and precision
minimum_record: Annual calculation worksheets/procedures for production, daily production, daily billed volume and unaccounted percentage
required_metadata: Actual production inputs; denominator; units; rounding; formulas; adjustments; exact worksheet cell/page references; source annual billed total if held or actual construction of daily statistic
acceptance_condition: Replicates each printed figure or documents each correction; actual source precision and definitions established.
acceptable_existing_alternative: Existing worksheet pages/cells or aggregate summary with year, units, source and formula; identify if no annual billed ledger total is held; no custom reconstruction requested.

question: Transition coverage and annual assignment
minimum_record: Actual coverage/assignment rule and worksheet reconciliation for Town/Village transition cohorts
required_metadata: Usage start/end; reading dates; issuance date; report-year assignment; volume-only corrections distinguished from dollar late fees; actual production period and affected billing groups
acceptance_condition: Shows which gallons enter each annual total under documented rules; no inferred actual dates or blanket 60-day multiplier.
followup_limit: Request native-cycle aggregate totals only if the initial worksheet/procedure is insufficient.
acceptable_existing_alternative: Existing schedule or transition memo with annual assignment procedure and relevant volume-adjustment totals; actual coverage still requires documentary support.

question: Customer/system/measurement scope
minimum_record: Executed/current scope reference and 2024/2025 production-meter/account inclusion statement
required_metadata: Included Village/Town district and wholesale groups; production-meter boundary; additions/removals; effective dates; exact references
acceptance_condition: Production and billing scope aligned or differences explicitly quantified and documented.
followup_limit: No customer names, addresses, account IDs or public address map needed.
acceptable_existing_alternative: Existing aggregate scope/inclusion statement and meter-chain reference; no customer list, coordinates or new map.

question: Existing work and usefulness
minimum_record: Written Water Master Plan title/version/date; accounting/water-loss sections and relevant later updates
required_metadata: Plan and appendix locators; baseline definitions; whether an update covers 2024/2025; public-use permissions; intended reporting decision
acceptance_condition: Written scope and inputs reviewed; any earlier explanation tested against common accounting definitions.
followup_limit: A 2023 presentation alone cannot establish a later 2024/2025 reconciliation.
acceptable_existing_alternative: Relevant existing plan sections/version, public link or custodian reference; no new study.

question: 2020/2022 percentages and 2021 precision
minimum_record: Specific formula/input/denominator clarification for 2020 and 2022; actual 2021 precision convention
required_metadata: Exact source worksheet/page/cell; correction history; denominator; units; annual/daily rounding
acceptance_condition: Documented rules reproduce printed values or retain explicit unresolved discrepancies; do not infer a copying error.
followup_limit: Keep 2023 qualifications unless independently supported; human review remains required.
acceptable_existing_alternative: Existing targeted calculation/procedure/correction pages only; historical clarification need not delay R01-R03.

question: Remaining period/correction bridge
minimum_record: Monthly production and native billing-cycle aggregate volumes, including adjacent overlapping cycles
required_metadata: Coverage/reading/issuance dates; unit; estimate-to-actual adjustments; report-year mapping; meter/account scope; signed changes
acceptance_condition: Aligned reconciliation without double counting; unexplained amounts remain unknown.
followup_limit: Only after R01-R03 leave a material unexplained difference and data access/contact is authorized.
acceptable_existing_alternative: Existing grouped native-cycle/month totals with coverage, scope, adjustments and adjacent-boundary allocation rules; document missing fields instead of fabricating an export.

question: Remaining authorized-use/measurement explanation
minimum_record: Existing aggregate use logs or documented estimates and relevant meter calibration/replacement records
required_metadata: Common period/scope; method and uncertainty; unavailable flags; source pages or entries
acceptance_condition: Uses and measurement adjustments documented separately; no residual equated with leakage.
followup_limit: Only after initial definition/period/scope reconciliation leaves a material difference.
acceptable_existing_alternative: Existing aggregate logs or documented estimates/calibration records with period, scope and uncertainty; unavailable logs remain unknown.
